item.title: The pet I’ll never forget: Boone the neglected puppy, rescued alongside 250 others
item.summary: Boone needed a home; my own dog needed company. When she picked him out at the shelter, all our lives took a turn for the better After 30 years working in the RSPCA , I had seen animals in unimaginable conditions. I saw dogs who had been left unattended at home for so long they began chewing doors and drinking water out of toilet bowls. I saw animals who had been stamped, kicked and even stabbed. But nothing could prepare me for Boone’s situation. Carson, the older of my two cocker spaniels, died in January. I could sense Bessie, an excitable bossy nine-year-old, was lonelier without him. They were both rescue animals. Carson was picked up by an RSPCA inspector and Bessie was abandoned at our local vet. Any dog I brought into our lives was a dog who needed a safe home.
